tweet.text:
Robinhood Chain is the hooks chain.

Builders are shipping Uniswap v4 integrations like crazy.

Most underrated way a v4 hook breaks?
A) Reentrancy during unlock callbacks
B) Fee/accounting rounding
C) Bad PoolManager assumptions

Real example from our reports 👇
